verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents official developer SDKs usable with RTX 50 Series GPUs. The CUDA Toolkit ships GPU-accelerated libraries, a C/C++ compiler, a runtime, and the Nsight optimization tools. Kernels can be written in C++ (CUDA Tile) or Python (cuTile). The RTX 5070 family page itself promotes curated, GPU-optimized SDKs across Windows ML, Ollama and PyTorch, and NGC hosts further SDKs and containers. A developer llms.txt is also served. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building with these SDKs on the 5070 Ti, and an explicit statement in the CUDA docs confirming 5070 Ti/Blackwell support.
